svg.title: How an update of the blueprint arrives
svg.desc: Right after every release of the blueprint, and every week, the blueprint bot runs copier update to the latest published release. When its pull request is still open and you have committed to its branch, the bot leaves the branch to you and says once that a newer release is out. Otherwise it opens the pull request, or moves the open one on to the new release. With conflicts, which turn auto-merge off, or with BLUEPRINT_AUTOMERGE set to off, it waits for the maintainer; otherwise it merges itself once every check passes.
